title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Acquires Kyle Marketplace in Kyle, TX
summary: Center is 98% occupied and anchored by an H-E-B Plus InvenTrust Properties Corp. (InvenTrust or the Company) today announced that it has acquired Kyle Marketplace, a 226,000 square foot H-E-B Plus-anchored center located in the south Austin suburb of Kyle, Texas, for approximately $59 million. This Smart News Release features multimedia.
